$comment: The stale page fix's shape, for the visualisers. From the trace; made by journalist.newsroom@PrompTugal.dinis.

speeds.what: plan reaches the owner to fix

pattern: the closest the record has come to the brief's workflow: a person hits a problem, a developer writes the plan (a diagnosis note), the owner builds it. Ownership, not skill, set the hand-off: the developer who found the bug could not touch the offline worker's files.

the_five_steps.2_request: conductor.B@ queues it, then sends it (07:49)
